speaker: Narrator

text: The Name We Left
speaker: Narrator
note: Chapter title. Leave a clean beat before story begins.

text: Three days after the shifted alley, they found the second one.
speaker: Narrator

text: This one was less polite.
speaker: Narrator

text: The passage opened in the middle of a functioning street while a water-seller was still arguing with a customer about measures. One moment the wall was ordinary brick. The next it had a dark mouth in it, narrow and already breathing cooler air.
speaker: Narrator

text: The water-seller glanced toward it once.
speaker: Narrator

text: His voice rose immediately.
speaker: Narrator

text: I filled the cup to the line.
speaker: Water-Seller

text: The line is crooked,
speaker: Water Customer

text: the customer said.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: The cup is old.
speaker: Water-Seller

text: So is your cheating.
speaker: Water Customer

text: People moved around the opening without slowing. A woman carrying reeds shifted her basket to avoid brushing the dark threshold. A pair of boys chased a wooden hoop past it and did not look inside.
speaker: Narrator

text: That was how the outer districts survived: by deciding certain things were someone else's problem.
speaker: Narrator

text: Balag stopped the nearest donkey with a hand on its neck.
speaker: Narrator

text: That's new.
speaker: Balag

text: The donkey leaned away from the passage hard enough to tighten its tether. Its ears flattened. A tremor moved beneath the skin of its neck.
speaker: Narrator

text: It's always new,
speaker: Enhedu

text: Enhedu said.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: She was already approaching the opening, eyes moving over the lintel, the floor, the edges where ordinary masonry had folded around something older.
speaker: Narrator

text: Ninsun did not wait for discussion.
speaker: Narrator

text: She was three steps inside before the rest of them finished looking at one another.
speaker: Narrator

text: Balag stared after her.
speaker: Narrator

text: She does know we usually check whether the floor exists.
speaker: Balag

text: She knows,
speaker: Zik

text: Zik said.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: That makes it worse.
speaker: Balag

text: Zik followed last, the way he had started doing without deciding to.
speaker: Narrator

text: The mark under the linen gave one low pulse and then went quiet again, as though it had registered the place and found nothing worth arguing about yet.
speaker: Narrator

text: He paused at the threshold and marked the wall with chalk.
speaker: Narrator

text: The line appeared pale against the dark brick.
speaker: Narrator

text: For an instant, another line showed beneath it.
speaker: Narrator

text: Older.
speaker: Narrator

text: Cut into the brick rather than drawn.
speaker: Narrator

text: Then it vanished under his fingers.
speaker: Narrator

text: Zik looked back at the street.
speaker: Narrator

text: The water-seller was still arguing.
speaker: Narrator

text: No one had noticed four people disappear into the wall.
speaker: Narrator

text: The passage was shorter than the first.
speaker: Narrator

text: Ten steps in, the street noise dulled.
speaker: Narrator

text: At fifteen, it stopped entirely.
speaker: Narrator

text: The walls were smooth and undecorated, their bricks laid without mortar. The ceiling sloped downward until Balag had to lower his head. The cold there was not the natural coolness of buried rooms. It gathered around their ankles first, then climbed slowly, as if rising from deep water.
speaker: Narrator

text: Enhedu touched the wall.
speaker: Narrator

text: Dry.
speaker: Enhedu

text: Ninsun held her lamp closer.
speaker: Narrator

text: No salt marks.
speaker: Ninsun

text: Then why does it smell flooded?
speaker: Balag

text: Balag asked.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: The passage smelled of clay after rain.
speaker: Narrator
